column1: # Name map r1: the game image's functions from 0x80086A50 up to 0x8009DC50, and the data they use.
# names-r1, wave 1 of the PC-only work (docs/port/PCONLY.md section 3). The readable map is docs/code/r1.md.
# Sources: the MAT3 decomp (cabi24/SFRush2049-mat3-decomp: decomp/src/GameSource/src, rush_types.h, symbols.txt)
# for every `mat3` row, matched by body (same constants, callees, fields, loop shapes); `code` rows are named for what
# the function does. MAT3 names that would collide with the C library (rand, strcmp, strncmp, strncpy, bsearch) or
# with common local names (magnitude, direction) are given `game_`/`vector_` names instead and say so.
# Things the lead should know before applying it:
# - Many MAT3 names here are already in the tree as file-static inlined copies of the same function (blast.c,
#   animate_arrow/group.c, audio_doppler_full.c) or as `#define MAT3Name old_name` aliases. Applying the map makes
#   those files declare the name twice (extern and static) unless their static copies go first; the #defines become
#   `#define X X`, harmless but worth deleting.
# - include/game/*.h (arcade-era headers) declare many of the same names with other signatures (CheckVisible(v, on),
#   PickCar(s16, s16), ...); nothing in src/blob includes them.
# - audiomgr_thread.c has a static `_SendCmd` (the decomp's name for posting to audio_cmd_queue): a different
#   function from MAT3 audiosfx.c's _SendCmd (audio_fade_control here); rename that static.
# - Empty retail stubs ("dead_stub", the seven song_dead_stub_*): deleted-procedure stubs IDO left where it inlined
#   a static; nothing calls them. Their names only describe where they sit; delete them in wave 2.
# - Stale labels in asm/us/blob/symbols.json inside this range, at addresses where no function starts (old guesses
#   by address, declared but never defined; drop them): render_init_setup render_mode_setup render_flush_buffer
#   audio_sync_wait render_sync_pipeline texture_load_start audio_task_start audio_call_wrapper message_send_async
#   entity_frame_advance entity_callback_invoke entity_state_init vi_config_offset input_dispatch physics_forces1
#   sfx_play poll_input physics_forces2 drone_move_update hud_update anim_frame_update physics_torques bgm_playback
#   ui_render jump_handler npc_interaction particles_animate voice_playback dma_complete_wait sound_3d_update
# - Second names at function starts (same address as a mapped function; unused but for frame_sync, mapped below in
#   the shared section): physics_velocities_L physics_forces_handler_B physics_velocities_M scheduler_jam
#   retrace_sync frame_sync physics_velocities_O physics_forces_handler_C input_connected_check input_button_adjust
#   input_analog_write input_handler dma_queue_sync dma_request track_render render_object. gDecompressedDataStart
#   (the image's first byte, also 0x80086A50) is the loader's and stays.
